posts.text: At Feastables we’ve been obsessed with getting the 1,000,000+ kids in illegal child on cocoa farms out of child labor. Had some major breakthrus recently, give this a listen if you’re curious. Hopefully between Feastables taking charge and my reach we can make change.

posts.text:
Happy Birthday America!

If I was born in any other country I wouldn’t be where I am today. I wasn’t born into wealth. I shouldn’t be MrBeast. This country gave me the freedom to chase my dreams and mindset that I can achieve anything. America isn’t perfect but dam I love her 🇺🇸
